task_summary: Comprehensive edge-case and layout regression mitigation: scroll-jump & jitter prevention on shrinking AutoExpandingTextarea (window.scrollY preservation, box-border, overflow-y-hidden); unmount synchronous localStorage flush and AbortController request-cancellation race prevention in useAutosave; portal-projected rail tooltips in collapsible 260px/76px Sidebar escaping overflow clipping; global WebKit autofill override and native dark mode select option styling; and text-scaling layout collision prevention with min-height tokens.
